tools.name: list_venues
tools.description: Every room Dubai Table books across Dubai: kind, area, which nights are Dubai Table nights, whether an exact table can be chosen, zones with seat and minimum-spend ranges, no booking fee, booking page and 360° tour links.

tools.name: whats_on
tools.description: The programme night by night — Dubai Table signature nights and venue nights — for the next N days from a date (default today in Dubai, 7 days, max 14).

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Tables still free at a venue on a date, from the live floor plan minus tables already requested or confirmed. Filter by party size, zone or maximum minimum-spend. Each table carries its zone, seats and minimum spend in AED.

tools.name: show_tables
tools.description: Render the interactive table picker for a venue and night (ChatGPT / MCP Apps hosts). Same table data as the availability list, shown as a visual picker with a form for the guest to request a table and pay the platform service fee.

tools.name: request_table
tools.description: Place a real table request with Dubai Table. Records the request, returns a booking reference (there is no booking fee and no payment link) and alerts the guest's relationship manager, who confirms with the venue on WhatsApp. Requires the guest's name and mobile number with country code. tools.name: booking_status
tools.description: Status of a request by reference (RZ-XXXXX) and the guest's phone number: pending, confirmed, seated, cancelled.

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel a request by reference and phone. There is no booking fee. The relationship manager confirms on WhatsApp.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Universal Commerce Protocol checkout. Creates a checkout session for one or more table requests. line_items[].item.id uses the grammar rz:<venue>:<table_id|zone:<Zone>|any>:<YYYY-MM-DD>:<party>. tools.name: get_checkout
tools.description: Fetch a UCP checkout session by id.

tools.name: update_checkout
tools.description: Replace line_items and/or buyer on a UCP checkout session.

tools.name: complete_checkout
tools.description: Complete a UCP checkout: places the table request(s) with Dubai Table. There is no booking fee, so the session completes without payment and the relationship manager confirms on WhatsApp.

tools.name: cancel_checkout
tools.description: Cancel a UCP checkout session (and its unpaid table request).

tools.name: desk_contact
tools.description: How to reach a relationship manager at Dubai Table (WhatsApp or email) for anything outside these venues, large groups, or special arrangements. Dubai Table's concierge arranges tables across all of Dubai.
